findings.title: A kill -9 of the top-level test run registers only if a toggler is already watching that process; a kill before or between race cases leaves the reparented vitest run to finish silently and report green.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.test.ts:340-366 and :397-403. Kills at +1.0 s and +1.5 s: the vitest CLI, esbuild and forks.js worker ran the full ~33.5 s and reported 20 passed with no message; a kill at +4.0 s reported "the test run was killed".
findings.consequence: The claim that a killed run always says so does not hold; an operator may believe a run stopped while it finishes. No toggler outlives its deadline and nothing leaks.

findings.title: HTML_PROXY_ID matches Vite's inline-script proxy ids but not the dev-mode <style> id form (?html-proxy&direct&index=N.css); the comment claims parity with Vite's matcher.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:173; a direct fetch of that id returned the page's own bytes through the checked path. Not reachable in the normal browser flow, where dev inlines style content.
findings.consequence: An overclaiming comment and an untested id shape; no outside file exposed.
